purpose: measure whether the emulator rejects a hardware-confirmed CMD8 CRC error for the same reason

specification_authority.version_used: 5.00 text distributed in the Version 5.10 PDF
specification_authority.normative_rule: CMD8 CRC verification is always enabled; a CRC error returns the R1 CRC-error indication regardless of command index

predicted_model_gap.backend_current_behavior: the sixth command byte is discarded and CMD8 returns the normal R7 response for any CRC
predicted_model_gap.prediction_if_hardware_oracle_matches: the frozen backend will pass the bad-CRC firmware and the first classification will be false_accept

baseline.required_hardware_result: CMD0 enters idle, CMD8 returns R1=01 and R7=000001aa, and SD initialization passes
baseline.required_emulator_result: the same-build BIN passes in the frozen backend

allowed_changes_from_baseline: the CMD8 CRC literal from 0x87 to 0x85
forbidden_changes: CMD0 or any CMD8 byte other than the CRC byte
SPI clock, mode, CS framing, response polling, R7 parsing, or timeout
backend source before the first hardware-confirmed fault run
hardware oracle after observing the result

fixed.required_source_change: restore only the CMD8 CRC literal to 0x87 and remove the fault identity
fixed.artifact_identity_rule: if the restored source reproduces the baseline BIN and UF2 hashes exactly, baseline hardware evidence also proves the fixed artifact and no third hardware run is required

execution_order: implement baseline observability and the correct 0x87 CMD8 path without filesystem access
freeze source, SDK commit, toolchain, timestamp, BIN, UF2, and source bundle from two clean builds
run the baseline BIN in the frozen backend and the same-build UF2 once on hardware through uf2loader; both must pass
derive the fault by changing only identity, evidence marker, and CMD8 CRC 0x87 to 0x85, then freeze its reproducible artifacts
run the fault UF2 on hardware before any fault BIN emulator run
only if hardware matches the frozen CMD8 CRC oracle exactly, run the same fault BIN once in backend commit 4a908648 and preserve PASS or FAIL unchanged
classify reason agreement before changing the backend
if the first result is false_accept, add exact CMD8 CRC handling to a new backend revision and prove the same fault BIN fails for COM_CRC_ERROR while all positive targets remain exact
restore the firmware CRC and prove the result is artifact-identical to the baseline or perform an explicit fixed hardware run
stop_conditions: baseline emulator or hardware result is not an exact pass
fault diff exceeds the allowed change budget
hardware result does not match CMD8 R1=09 and the frozen reason fields
artifact or boot identity is incomplete

human_operations.retry_policy: retry only an invalid capture with missing identity or incomplete UART, at most once per artifact; an oracle mismatch is evidence and is not retried
human_operations.third_fixed_run: not required when the fixed artifact hashes exactly match the already hardware-passed baseline

media_and_loader_controls.reason: the application tests the normal PicoCalc launch path, CMD0 resets the card protocol before CMD8, and no flash-layout or loader-reservation property is under test
